title: DeGroot Dynamics on Multiplex Networks with Directed and Acyclic Interlayer Connectivities
abstract: arXiv:2610.27198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In models of opinion dynamics, researchers typically examine how an individual's opinion on one topic is influenced by the opinions of their neighbors in a network. However, people's opinions on a topic are also influenced by their opinions and their neighbors' opinions on related topics. In an election, for example, the opinions of a voter on a variety of issues inform their opinions of electoral candidates. To consider the influence between people's opinions on multiple distinct topics, we study a multiplex extension of the traditional DeGroot consensus model. In our multiplex DeGroot model, different network layers represent distinct topics and directed interlayer edges (which are not allowed to form cycles) encode relationships between distinct topics. translated_title: 具有有向无环层间连接的多重网络上的DeGroot动力学
translated_abstract: 在舆论动力学模型中，研究者通常考察个体对某一主题的观点如何受到网络中邻居观点的影响。然而，人们对某一主题的观点也会受到他们自己对相关主题的观点以及邻居对这些相关主题观点的影响。例如，在选举中，选民对各种议题的看法会影响其对候选人的评价。为了考虑人们对多个不同主题的观点之间的影响，我们研究了传统DeGroot共识模型的一种多重网络扩展。在我们的多重DeGroot模型中，不同的网络层代表不同的主题，有向的层间边（不允许形成环路）编码了不同主题之间的关系。在该模型中，个体对某一主题的观点既受到其邻居在该主题上观点的影响，也受到其自身在相关主题上观点的影响。我们证明了在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将经典DeGroot共识模型扩展到多重网络，用不同网络层表示不同主题、用有向无环的层间连接表示主题间关系，使个体的观点同时受到同层邻居观点和自身相关主题观点的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the classical DeGroot consensus model to multiplex networks, where distinct layers represent distinct topics and directed acyclic interlayer edges encode topic relationships, so that individuals' opinions on one topic are influenced by both their neighbors' opinions on that topic and their own opinions on related topics.
